paper.subject: astronomy
paper.title: Observational Examination (OM)
paper.caveat: The sky map on which the answers are to be marked is not part of this document.

transcription.verifiedBy: mechanical:textlayer+regions (mechanical check only: schema, text layer, printed figures; no second model, prompt mech-v1)
transcription.notes: One-page question sheet; the sky map itself is not in this PDF, so there are no figures to crop (the IOAA logo is decorative). The two side-by-side tables of each task are transcribed as two Markdown tables in printed order; the empty third row of the right-hand galaxy table is kept. No total is printed (the boxed points sum to 50). No official solutions in the archive.

problems.title: OM1
problems.statement:
Mark any 5 (five) of the following stars on the map by putting a circle (O) around the appropriate star and writing its code next to it. If you mark more than 5 stars, only the first 5 in serial order will be considered.

| Code | Name | Bayer Name |
|---|---|---|
| S1 | Caph | $\beta$ Cas |
| S2 | Asellus Australis | $\delta$ Cnc |
| S3 | Acrux | $\alpha$ Cru |
| S4 | Alphard | $\alpha$ Hya |

| Code | Name | Bayer Name |
|---|---|---|
| S5 | Sheliak | $\beta$ Lyr |
| S6 | Albireo | $\beta$ Cyg |
| S7 | Rasalhague | $\alpha$ Oph |
| S8 | Kaus Australis | $\epsilon$ Sgr |

solution.incompleteReason: The archive has no official solution for this paper.

problems.title: OM2
problems.statement:
Mark location of any 3 (three) of the following galaxies on the map by putting a ‘+’ sign at appropriate place in the map and writing its code next to it. If you mark more than 3 galaxies, only the first 3 in serial order will be considered.

| Code | Name | M number |
|---|---|---|
| G1 | Triangulum Galaxy | M 33 |
| G2 | Whirlpool Galaxy | M 51 |
| G3 | Southern Pinwheel Galaxy | M 83 |

| Code | Name | M number |
|---|---|---|
| G4 | Virgo A | M 87 |
| G5 | Sombrero Galaxy | M 104 |
|  |  |  |
